tweet_summary: Image-overlay meme of AOC with the impact-font caption: 'Republicans are trying to rig elections by only allowing U.S. citizens to vote!' — posted without a satire/parody label and amplified by replies treating it as a real quote.
why_note_decision: Snopes, Media Bias/Fact Check, factually.co, and AOC's press secretary all confirm AOC never said this. The quote originated as satire (Genesius Times) but is being amplified as a real statement. Multiple replies in this tweet's thread accept it as genuine ('I could 100% see her saying this'). Original note correctly says the quote is not real but used weak sources (her X feed and a factcheck.org category page) instead of citing the dedicated Snopes/MBFC fact-checks. Reference note should cite those.
judge_guidance: PASS if the note (1) states the quote is fabricated/not a real AOC statement, and (2) cites a dedicated reputable fact-check (Snopes article specifically debunking this quote, Media Bias/Fact Check, AFP, Reuters, or AP). PASS also if it notes the meme originated from a satire site (Genesius Times). FAIL if the note: relies only on 'searches of her X feed return nothing' or generic factcheck.org category links (the original note's failure), treats it as possibly real, or calls it merely 'unverified' without a fact-check source.
reference_note: Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez never said this. Snopes and other fact-checkers confirm the quote is fabricated; her press secretary denied it. The line originated from satire site Genesius Times. https://www.snopes.com/fact-check/aoc-gop-rig-elections-quote/ https://mediabiasfactcheck.com/fact-check-did-aoc-say-gop-rig-elections-by-allowing-citizens-only/

original_unhelpful_note.text: This is not a real quote from Rep. Ocasio-Cortez. Searches of her official X account return no such statement, and fabricated quotes attributed to her are common. https://x.com/AOC https://www.factcheck.org/person/alexandria-ocasio-cortez/
original_unhelpful_note.failure_reason: sources_missing_or_unreliable — links a general X profile and a topic-page on factcheck.org rather than a dedicated fact-check of this specific fabricated quote (Snopes, MBFC, factually.co, MSN all have direct debunks).

fact_check.notes: AOC press secretary on record: 'She did not say that.' Quote traces to satire site Genesius Times.

importance.lens_rationale: Fabricated quotes attributed to prominent politicians degrade civic discourse; 41K-impression post by a 242K-follower account adds to a broader misinformation pattern.
